title: The Blessings of Nature
description: Help Danica Pure-Spring restore the Gildergreen tree in Whiterun by retrieving Nettlebane from hagravens at Orphan Rock and obtaining sap from the Eldergleam, or a sapling through Maurice Jondrelle's peaceful intervention.

base_facts: I am the priestess of the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun.
The Gildergreen tree outside the temple was struck by lightning and is dying.
Sap from the parent tree, the Eldergleam, can restore the Gildergreen.
A special dagger called Nettlebane is needed to cut the Eldergleam, held by hagravens at Orphan Rock.

GILDERGREEN_PROBLEM: Someone has asked about the Gildergreen's condition.
AGREE_TO_HELP: An adventurer has agreed to help restore the Gildergreen.
NETTLEBANE_RETURNED: The adventurer returned with Nettlebane from the hagravens.
ELDERGLEAM_MISSION: The adventurer has gone to the Eldergleam Sanctuary to retrieve sap.
SAPLING_CHOICE: The adventurer chose Maurice's peaceful path and took a sapling instead of cutting the Eldergleam.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Gildergreen has been restored thanks to the adventurer's help.

base_facts: I am a pilgrim who traveled far to worship beneath the Gildergreen.
I am distressed that the sacred tree has withered.
I wish to visit the Eldergleam, the parent tree of the Gildergreen.

NETTLEBANE_RETURNED: I asked to accompany the adventurer to the Eldergleam Sanctuary.
ELDERGLEAM_MISSION: I am traveling with the adventurer to see the Eldergleam.
SAPLING_CHOICE: I prayed to the Eldergleam and a sapling appeared, sparing the ancient tree.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Gildergreen will be renewed through a new sapling.

beats.comment: Player learns about the dying Gildergreen tree and Danica's need for help.
Player agrees to help Danica restore the Gildergreen by retrieving Nettlebane.
Player retrieved Nettlebane from the hagravens and brought it to Danica.
Danica sends player to the Eldergleam Sanctuary to retrieve sap.
Player chose Maurice's peaceful path and took a sapling instead of cutting the Eldergleam.
Quest complete - player returned with sap or sapling to restore the Gildergreen.
